feeds.title: Autostraddle
feeds.description: Founded in March 2009 by Riese Bernard and Alexandra Vega and still run by a dedicated team of passionate weirdos, Autostraddle is an intelligent, hilarious & provocative voice and a progressively feminist online community for multiple generations of kickass lesbian, bisexual & otherwise inclined ladies. Follow to get News, Entertainment, Opinion, Community and Girl-on-Girl Culture.

feeds.title: Lesbian.com: Connecting Lesbians Worldwide
feeds.description: Lesbian.com strives to enrich and empower the global lesbian community by serving as the online hub for lesbian life. Their primary goal is to create an inclusive, informative and entertaining resource for lesbians everywhere. Follow and get lesbian news, travel, entertainment, movies, comics, photos, activism, community and more.

feeds.title: Travel with Mei and Kerstin
feeds.description: Welcome to Travel with Mei & Kerstin! We're a married lesbian couple from Luxembourg, who's been exploring the world together since 2002. Exploring places we haven't been to yet. Understanding different cultures. Learning about other civilizations. And putting our experiences, ideas, and memories down in words. These are passions that united us when we met. And these are the passions that still bond us. Road trips. City trips. Urban escapes. Weekend getaways. Or just a walk in the woods...The more we travel, the more we love it.

feeds.title: The Seattle Lesbian
feeds.description: The Seattle Lesbian is a daily online newspaper operating from offices in the Pacific Northwest, and reaching communities spanning continents around the world. The Seattle Lesbian has changed the landscape of lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) life by providing thought-provoking content with substantial relevancy on various angles of discussion and advocacy.

feeds.title: The Lesbrary - A Lesbian and Bi Women Book Blog
feeds.description: The Lesbrary is a book blog all about les/bi/etc books. Yes, this often means lesbian books (hence the name), but includes anything in the broad 'doesn't identify as a man and is at least some of the time attracted romantically and/or sexually to others who do not identify as a man' category. Lesbrary books don't have to be written by a queer author, though it helps. Follow this blog to get all latest news and reviews of lesbian (and bisexual women, etc) books!

feeds.title: June Mazer Lesbian Archives - Where Lesbians Live Forever! Blog
feeds.description: We are one of the biggest Lesbian Archives in the world and we are right here in West Hollywood! The June Mazer Lesbian Archives of Los Angeles and Southern California houses almost a century of lesbian and feminist artwork, manuscripts, books, records, etc.

feeds.title: Dorothy Surrenders
feeds.description: A gay gal's guide to pop culture. Why let the boys have all the fun? Misanthropic, but in a nice way. Contributor to Autostraddle

feeds.title: Little Gay Book - Lesbian Matchmaking by Dr. Frankie
feeds.description: Lesbian Matchmaker Dr. Frankie Bashan finds the woman of your dreams, so you don't have to. Not online dating. For women who don't have time to date. Private Matchmaking and events for lesbian women in the San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, San Diego and New York. Her mission is finding love & giving healthy relationship advice for the single lesbian.

feeds.title: Queer Fat Femme
feeds.description: Welcome to the QueerFatFemme, chronicling Bevin Branlandingham's relentless pursuit of joy. Featuring advice, glitter, fat fashion, dating, sex, shopping, travel, events, community building and anecdotes from the life of a Queer Fat Femme artist, healer, community leader. Bevin Branlandingham's mission is to make the world a safe place for people to love themselves, regardless of their differences

feeds.title: Alpennia Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Heather Rose Jones, She blogs about research into lesbian-like motifs in history and literature at the Lesbian Historic Motif Project which provides inspiration for her fiction.

feeds.title: Adventures of WifeSquared
feeds.description: We are a lesbian married couple who loves to eat and explore our way through the world.

feeds.title: Qwear
feeds.description: Qwear is a Boston-based style blog for queer women, trans* people, and the dappers who love them.

feeds.title: Jenjsilver
feeds.description: Author Jen Silver enjoys reading an eclectic range of genres including sci-fi, fantasy, historical fiction, and lesbian fiction. Read her latest musings and thoughts on this blog. She lives near Hebden Bridge in West Yorkshire, England with her long-term partner.

feeds.title: The Legacy of Leo
feeds.description: Bittersweet Motherhood blog following life after stillbirth, miscarriage and pregnancy after loss. In memory of our son, Leo Phoenix, born 17.01.16 at 37 weeks. Fundraising, volunteering, awareness raising, and general surviving.

feeds.title: Velvetpark
feeds.description: Velvetpark is a content-rich community portal for lesbians, queers, our friends and allies. Velvetpark Media is a 501(c)3 dedicated to fostering and educating queer women's subcultures in the arts, academia, and activism.

feeds.title: The Rainbow Remix
feeds.description: Join South FL singer JD Danner and Podcaster Denise Warner in a new show featuring LGBTQ lifestyle news, music, arts, media, mixology and more

feeds.title: LesbianEarth Blog
feeds.description: LesbianEarth blogs for and by lesbians. Lesbian blogs four our community. Your Lesbian World Monthly Newsletter - Sign up-its free!

feeds.title: Lesbian Herstory Archives Blog
feeds.description: In Memory of the Voices That We Have Lost

feeds.title: The Lesbrary
feeds.description: The Lesbrary is a book blog about bi and lesbian books, mostly made up of book reviews, but also features a collection of all the latest lesbian and bi-lit news and guest posts. You can browse by Genre, Category, or representation.

feeds.title: Lesbian Connection
feeds.description: The free worldwide forum of news & ideas for, by and about lesbians

feeds.title: The Gay & Lesbian Review
feeds.description: The Gay & Lesbian Review is a bimonthly magazine of history, culture, and politics targeting an educated readership of LGBT people, and their allies that publishes essays in a wide range of disciplines as well as reviews of books, movies, and plays. Our mission is to promote equal rights and equality for all sexual and gender minorities, advance the intellectual life of LGBT people, and educate a broader public on LGBT topics.

feeds.title: Nonchalant
feeds.description: Cutting edge content for LGBTQ+, lesbian women, non-binary people & allies; covering dating, fashion, lesbian movies, queer events, and more.

feeds.title: Lesbian Culture Club Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest news and stories from the Lesbian Culture Club in Portland, OR. Explore articles on community events, and inspiring stories. Join our vibrant community!

feeds.title: AfterEllen
feeds.description: AfterEllen.com works the lesbian/bi pop culture beat with a fun, feminist perspective on film, television, music, books, and sports. They also cover lifestyle issues like lesbian sex and dating, coming out, and our take on the current political climate as it affects our community. Follow AfterEllen to get the latest update from lesbian world.

feeds.title: Proud Parenting
feeds.description: Proud Parenting shares love, commitment, and family values. LGBTQ Parents - Lesbian Moms & Gay Dads. Follow this website to see world's largest photo gallery of same-sex parents & their families.

feeds.title: Only Once Today
feeds.description: We're Lobke and Inge, a regular lesbian couple. Travel is always in the back of our minds. The urge to explore new land and discover the gems of the world is bigger than ever. We need to roam the earth. This blog is all about that venture. You can read stories about our past travels and tips and tricks we learned on the road.

feeds.title: Only Women
feeds.description: Only Women is a lesbian & bisexual dating & social networking service for those who identify as female. Built from the ground up by a gay owned and operated indie company, we strive to give you the best dating experience possible.

feeds.title: UNFEMME
feeds.description: Gender-neutral fashion tips for stud lesbians, tomboy girls, and nonbinary people, Dating advice for lesbians, LGBTQ culture, Dapper & androgynous fashion from UNFEMME.

feeds.title: GirlfriendsMeet - Lesbian Dating Blog
feeds.description: GirlfriendsMeet.com is a free bi-sexual dating site where you can find, meet, & connect with lesbian singles in your area. Safe, fun & easy bi-sex dating. Establish real lesbian relationships, friendships or even dive into casual lesbian dating.

feeds.title: The Gayby Project
feeds.description: One research obsessed post-punk political dyke and one wonder-endowed post-modern theater professor fall in love and decide to make some babies. Hilarity, awkwardness and, sometimes, tenderheartedness, ensues. Herein lies an adventure of queer infertility and making a family without biology on your side.

feeds.title: What Wegan Did Next - Lesbians, Love, Long Distance
feeds.description: This is a blog to detail the life of Wegan. Who or what is Wegan I hear you ask? We are Whitney & Megan, a femme (aka 'lipstick') lesbian couple who endured four years of long distance between Hawaii & the UK. Follow the love and life of happily married femme lesbian couple 'Wegan'.

feeds.title: Freedom to Marry Blog
feeds.description: Freedom to Marry is the campaign working to win marriage nationwide. We partner with a diverse range of organizations and supporters across the country to end the exclusion of same-sex couples from the responsibilities, protections, and commitment of marriage.

feeds.title: Dykestowatchoutfor.com Blog
feeds.description: Alison Bechdel's comic strip Dykes To Watch Out For became a countercultural institution among lesbians and discerning non-lesbians all over the planet.

feeds.title: Bounding Over Our Steps
feeds.description: We're the traveling team of Ligeia, a US-American, and Mindy, a Canadian, currently calling Florida, USA home, where Ligeia is an ESL language instructor and Mindy works in freelance web design, both professions allowing for a nomadic life. We started this blog way back in December 2005, with the primary intention of keeping our friends and family up to date with what was going on with us. Today, we hope to reach a broader audience that is not only interested in our daily lives, but also fellow travelers that share one or more similar interests.

feeds.title: The Flannel Files
feeds.description: Rae Theodore's BUTCH blog about living in the middle of girl/boy. 40-something butch lesbian. Married in 2014. I refer to my better half as W.

feeds.title: Feral Librarian
feeds.description: Chris is a US Army veteran, erstwhile sociologist and feral librarian. I like to write about libraries, scholarly publishing, social justice issues, sports, and music.

feeds.title: The Long Way Home
feeds.description: My Journey To Acceptance And Freedom. My name is Dace (pronounced Dorsay) and I was born in a dinky country called Latvia thinking that my life's purpose was to find a husband, get a white picket fence, produce a child or two, and get a dog. However, there was a small just a small problem. I was gay.

feeds.title: Hound Mamas
feeds.description: Two moms, two hounds, and a baby. I'm Molly and my wife is Catch. We spent about 2 years trying to conceive our miracle baby and were finally successful after a round of IVF and a FET that resulted in a twin pregnancy. We lost one of our twins, but our miracle baby A stuck with us. Charlotte was born on July 23, 2015, and is the light of our life.

feeds.title: An American Lesbian in London
feeds.description: A sarcastic, funny LGBT-based blog by a sometimes-cranky, over 40, jeans & t-shirt, cat-loving chick. The title says it all. I am an American lesbian living in London, England. I was born in Niagara Falls, NY and moved to South Florida, where I lived for the last 25 years. I married my wife, Jemma, in Oct 2010, who lives in the UK and I moved here that March.

feeds.title: Pepibebe - Nurturing by Nature
feeds.description: A journey of two Mamas trying to make babies the natural way... One half of a Maori/NewZealandWhite/Afro-Caribbean duo who were trying (again & again) to conceive our long awaited first child.

feeds.title: MainelyButch - Existing Outside the Gender Binary
feeds.description: I am a pretty relaxed, proud, Butch lesbian and a native Mainer who enjoys reading, writing, blogging, vlogging and social interaction.

feeds.title: Les Talk, More Travel
feeds.description: Les Talk, More Travel is about local and international adventures for adventurous queers, lovers of the Pacific Northwest, and other interested humans! Les, I'm Leslie, a Canadian currently living in Victoria, British Columbia. Occasionally I like to write about LGBT-related issues and lesbian travel.

feeds.title: Not Sisters - Yet Another Other Mother Blog
feeds.description: I'm a lady. So is my wife. And like so many other female-female couples whose features are not dissimilar, we spend rather a lot of time explaining to people that we are not sisters. So who are we? We're wives. We're mothers.

feeds.title: A Lesbian's View
feeds.description: Welcome to a Lesbian's view of the world.

feeds.title: Edmonton Lesbian Book Club
feeds.description: Our book club for lesbians reads mostly fiction (and some autobiographical and/or bio-fiction) by lesbian authors.

feeds.title: My Online (and Offline) Lesbian Dating Stories
feeds.description: The stories of a single lesbian living in Brighton...I am a single lesbian living in Brighton and looking for my other half... In my quest to find love I date girls that I meet online... I keep believing that love is out there... somewhere... but judging from my luck in dates it seems that love is not very easy to find...

feeds.title: The Sartorial Butch
feeds.description: The musings of a well dressed butch/faggot/homo/queer. A peek into the closet and mind of a slightly narcissistic yet always well dressed homo

feeds.title: New Lesbian
feeds.description: I'm a new lesbian. i write about it. i'm 34, divorced from a man, loving women, and in the middle of the constant process of living my true, authentic life, for the very first time. i am a lesbian, and only realized this about myself at age 29.

feeds.title: Anomalous Allure
feeds.description: Sonia, twenty one, Canadian Prairies, broke femme, fat, queer, sleepy. Into spoken word, ceramics, zines, and cheap fashions.

feeds.title: ButchOnTap
feeds.description: Be Butch. I am a butch. This blog is about what I think.

feeds.title: Radically Queer
feeds.description: My name is Avory Faucette, and I am an award-winning queer feminist legal activist. I blog on topics including queer and trans identities, gender and sexuality issues in the law, international human rights, sexuality in diverse groups, and the intersections between different types of oppression.

feeds.title: Lesbians That Are Single
feeds.description: Feel free to submit a photo and/or description of yourself. Hopefully you'll meet some awesome people.

feeds.title: BigBooButch - Memoirs of a Butch Lesbian
feeds.description: I'm a Butch giving the finger to the patriarchy daily by living my life as a masculine woman with no apologies. I am here to post my truths and to show that Butches are still around. We're not going anywhere.

feeds.title: Butch Wonders
feeds.description: I'm a thirty something woman who started this blog in 2011 because I realized that I had a lot to say about life as a butch lesbian--particularly about fashion, but also about everyday things: getting sir'd in the restroom, trying to get a decent haircut, etc. I write about everything from butch fashion to relationships to getting sir'd in the restroom.

feeds.title: RainbowWeddingNetwork.com Blog
feeds.description: The nation's leading Gay & Lesbian Wedding resource featuring a network of screened gay-friendly vendors across North America. RainbowWeddingNetwork is also the proud event producer of Same Love, Same Rights National Tour of Gay & Lesbian Wedding Expos.

feeds.title: Two Moms to Be
feeds.description: Jen and Allison are two lesbians who had their first child in January 2011 and are expecting their second child in December 2012.

feeds.title: A Lesbian and Her Laptop
feeds.description: 'A Lesbian and Her Laptop' is a WordPress blog that began in fall 2017. It holds a collection of thoughtful creative nonfiction pieces, fun list-posts, and content reviews with one running theme: The Queer Experience. As the blog continues to grow, I hope it serves as a hopeful place to all queer readers to feel understood, informed, and inspired.

feeds.title: Notes By J
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm JJ. I'm a lesbian book lover, Netflix addict, and movie fan. This blog is dedicated to things that will help you escape your stressy, messy, adult existence - whether that is books, travel, movies, or TV Shows.

feeds.title: Mombian
feeds.description: Mombian is a lifestyle site for lesbian moms and other LGBT parents, offering a mix of parenting, politics, diversions, and resources for all our varied roles.

feeds.title: Australian Gay and Lesbian Law Blog
feeds.description: Australian gay and lesbian law issues by an LGBTI friendly Brisbane lawyer. All about discrimination, parenting, property settlement, same sex domestic violence,same sex law issues.

feeds.title: Everyone Is Gay
feeds.description: Advice, Laughter, and Resources for LGBTQIA Youth. Everyone Is Gay works to improve the lives of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Questioning/Queer (LGBTQ) youth using a three-pronged approach: providing honest advice to these youth while keeping them laughing; talking to students across the country in an effort to create caring, compassionate school environments.

feeds.title: Meet the Wildes
feeds.description: Modern love story of two woman and their family. I'm Amber, and Meet the Wildes is a modern love story about two women who fell in love, and the family they made together. Mostly I write about my life with my partner, Kirsty, and our two sets of twins - boys born in October 14 and girls born in July 16.

feeds.title: LesBeMums
feeds.description: We are LesBeMums, two wives from Brighton (UK) embarking on parenthood for the first time. We write about our lives in our blog, in particular our current journey through parenthood, how we got there, as well as our experiences as same-sex parents.

feeds.title: Secute Lesbian
feeds.description: Laura, 20, lesbian, German. Official HER app team. Here to help and give advice. No matter what it's about, just message me! ♥

feeds.title: Love Gay Girls Advice
feeds.description: Single , Dutch. Hey guysI started this blog because I will express myself about my sexuality, I like to post some awesome stuff about gay things. I'm lesbian and I known that since I was 13.

feeds.title: Girls Who Like Girls
feeds.description: Welcome to JGWLG! This is a blog designed to help you ladies meet other people in the LGBT family, near or far!

feeds.title: Adventurous Moms
feeds.description: The travels and adventures of two moms and their 4 little boos! Outdoor adventurer. Traveler. Writer. Photographer. Filmmaker. Communications Professor.
